headline: WOMEN WIN THE VOTE: 19th Amendment Ratified After Decades of Struggle
dispatch: Secretary of State Bainbridge Colby certified the Nineteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution this morning in Washington, completing ratification after Tennessee cast the decisive 36th state vote. The amendment prohibits denial of the right to vote on account of sex, enfranchising millions of American women for the first time. Suffragists who marched, petitioned, and faced arrest for decades gathered outside government buildings to mark the moment.
answer: 19th Amendment ratified, granting U.S. women the vote, 1920
